tooltipsFallback.scenario: Choose the situation: prior client contact, first outreach, or a proactive offer after ROI analysis. The tone of the entire document depends on the scenario.
tooltipsFallback.scenario_after_contact: The client already spoke with you: call, email, brief, or quote request. The document references the discussion and leads to project kickoff.
tooltipsFallback.scenario_cold_outreach: First touch with no prior contact. No “thanks for reaching out” or “as we discussed”. CTA is a short meeting, not contract signing.
tooltipsFallback.scenario_proactive_offer: You propose automation after analysis (often from the calculator). Focus on ROI and the process — the client did not request a quote.
tooltipsFallback.prior_contact_summary: Briefly: when and what you discussed, what the client asked for, agreements. The model uses this in the greeting and task understanding block.
tooltipsFallback.problem_source: How you know about the problem without contact: process observation, industry pattern, referral, public data. Do not invent facts — describe the basis.
tooltipsFallback.include_pricing: On: the proposal includes a specific price and payment terms. Off (soft CP): price after diagnostics, CTA is a meeting. Useful for cold first emails.
tooltipsFallback.client_company: Legal or trade name of the company the proposal is addressed to. In cold outreach you can address the company without a contact name.
tooltipsFallback.client_contact: Recipient name or title. Optional for cold outreach. If provided — used in the greeting without faking prior dialogue (unless “after contact”).
tooltipsFallback.client_industry: Helps the model choose industry wording and typical pain points.
tooltipsFallback.client_problem: Describe the client pain in your words: what fails, how much time or money is lost, consequences. Goes into the “Understanding the task” block.
tooltipsFallback.calculator_run: Link a ready ROI run from Automation Calculator — the model inserts savings, payback, and NPV figures into the proposal text.
tooltipsFallback.solution_name: Short project title for the proposal header, e.g. “Lead intake automation”.
tooltipsFallback.solution_description: What you propose to do: high-level scope, key technologies or approach. Do not duplicate deliverables — this is the why and how.
tooltipsFallback.deliverables: Concrete artifacts and outcomes: documents, integrations, training, support. One item per line.
tooltipsFallback.project_cost: Used only when “Include price” is on. Amount in ₽ for the cost block and PDF.
tooltipsFallback.timeline_weeks: Total project duration. Phases in the document should fit this timeline.
tooltipsFallback.payment_schedule: Payment scheme for a full proposal. Ignored in soft mode without price.
tooltipsFallback.sender_company: Integrator or consultant company sending the proposal.
tooltipsFallback.sender_contact: Sender name for signature and next-step block.
tooltipsFallback.sender_phone: Contact phone in the document signature.
